To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
neurological complications are common in childhood solid tumors and that they can be associated with significant morbidity.
Neurological complications were seen in 33% of the cases with childhood solid malignant tumors, with the highest incidence in neuroblastoma/ganglionuroblastoma (45.8%).
51 (33%) of 154 children with solid malignant tumors had 64 neurological complications, 10 of them died and 3 of the 41 surviving patients had neurological sequelae.

the neurological complications of childhood solid tumors.
the neurological complications of solid malignant childhood tumors.
the neurological complications of childhood malignancies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
neurological complications are a common problem in the management of childhood malignant solid tumors.
the neurological complication is a common problem in childhood solid malignant tumors and it is a major problem in survivors of the disease.
neurological complications of childhood malignancies can be devastating.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the prognosis of childhood solid malignant neoplasms is not worsened by the occurrence of neurological complications, but neurological complications may lead to long term neurological sequelae.
the prognosis for patients with childhood malignancies is good, and the prognosis for patients who suffer with neurological complication is also good.
the incidence rate for neurological complications in children with non-CNS solid malignancies is high, and it is not associated with an increased mortality.
The main takeaway from our work is that
neurological complications are common and can be severe in children with solid tumors.
neurological complications of childhood malignancies can occur and are often not life threatening.
we should always keep a high index of suspicion when we see neurological complications in patients with childhood solid tumors.
